Legal entity is 650 Industries, Inc., founded 2015/2016 by Charlie Cheever (Quora co-founder) and James Ide. Raised a $45M Series B (led by Georgian; Preqin cites $44.32M at a $299.75M post-money valuation) in April 2026, alongside launching an 'Expo Agent' AI coding-assistant product; revenue/ARR and total funding figures beyond the Series B itself rest on third-party estimates (Growjo, techcompanynews.com/Preqin), not a company-disclosed number.
